## 🚀 Models & datasets released this week

- <a id="st-c71b778862b5" class="st-a"></a>**Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B parameters, 12B active) and Lightning (30B, 3B active) are open hybrid Mamba–Transformer mixture-of-experts models aimed at agent workloads.** Mamba layers are a state-space alternative to attention that keep memory flat as context grows. Super is multimodal and was trained with RL and multi-teacher distillation; Nvidia reports 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro (a software-engineering benchmark), above its larger Nemotron 3 Ultra with about 4.6× fewer active parameters, and 4-bit NVFP4 weights that recover 99.62% of full-precision accuracy. Lightning is the base model the RSI Arena agents above trained. ([arXiv:2610.38095](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38095) · NVIDIA · `[preprint]` `[vendor PR]`)
